title: Keyed Tuple Lists (lists:keyfind/3, keystore/4) & proplists
solutionExplanation: Demonstrates C BIF keylist search/update with lists:keyfind/3 and lists:keystore/4 alongside proplist option parsing.

otpDocCards.description: Searches the list of tuples for the first tuple whose Nth element matches Key. Implemented as a C BIF in ERTS.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(N) linear search, optimized in C.

otpDocCards.description: Returns the value of a key in a proplist, or Default if missing.

mentalModelCheck.question: In the tuple {product, 42, "Laptop", 1200, 5}, what position integer N must be passed to lists:keyfind to match against product ID 42?

options.label: 2, because Erlang tuple positions are strictly 1-indexed, so position 1 is the atom product and position 2 is 42
options.explanation: In Erlang, element(1, Tuple) is the first element, so ID 42 is at position 2.

options.label: 1, because arrays and tuples in computer science are 0-indexed
options.explanation: Erlang tuples are 1-indexed in all BIFs (element/2, setelement/3, lists:keyfind/3).

options.label: 0, to specify the key offset relative to the tuple tag
options.explanation: Position must be a positive integer >= 1.
